nodes.label: FinBERT Sentiment Intelligence
nodes.rationale: FinBERT (ProsusAI/finbert) replaces TextBlob for contextual financial sentiment. Identifies Hawkish/Dovish shifts in Fed sentiment days before FRED quantitative data reflects them.

nodes.label: Sentiment-Augmented Liquidity Index (SALI)
nodes.rationale: Lexicon-based lighter alternative to FinBERT. Combines ILI with sentiment using configurable weighting (70/30) or AND-gate logic. Both TA and SA branches must agree for signal confirmation.
